completed_tasks.details: Used .onConflict('key').ignore().returning('key') with strict array-length check for cycle lease, invoice claims, and credit note claims. Enforced RELATIONAL_INVOICES_TABLE_REQUIRED and RELATIONAL_CREDIT_NOTES_TABLE_REQUIRED outside tests.

completed_tasks.name: P0-2: Gateway Refund Amount Normalization (Razorpay & Cashfree)
completed_tasks.details: Implemented parseNormalizedRefundPayload returning integer minor units and decimal major units. Enforced positive amounts, currency matching, cumulative partial refund limits, and duplicate webhook idempotency.
